options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: approval_config
options.description: Configuration for manual approval to start a build invocation of this BuildTrigger. Builds created by this trigger will require approval before they execute. Any user with a Cloud Build Approver role for the project can approve a build.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: bitbucket_server_trigger_config
options.description: BitbucketServerTriggerConfig describes the configuration of a trigger that creates a build whenever a Bitbucket Server event is received.

options.name: build
options.description: Contents of the build template. Either a filename or build template must be provided.

options.name: description
options.description: Human-readable description of the trigger.

options.name: developer_connect_event_config
options.description: Configuration for triggers that respond to Developer Connect events.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Whether the trigger is disabled or not. If true, the trigger will never result in a build.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: filename
options.description: Path, from the source root, to a file whose contents is used for the template. Either a filename or build template must be provided. Set this only when using trigger_template or github. When using Pub/Sub, Webhook or Manual set the file name using git_file_source instead.

options.name: filter
options.description: A Common Expression Language string. Used only with Pub/Sub and Webhook.

options.name: git_file_source
options.description: The file source describing the local or remote Build template.

options.name: github
options.description: Describes the configuration of a trigger that creates a build whenever a GitHub event is received.

options.name: ignored_files
options.description: ignoredFiles and includedFiles are file glob matches using https://golang.org/pkg/path/filepath/#Match extended with support for `**`. If ignoredFiles and changed files are both empty, then they are not used to determine whether or not to trigger a build. If ignoredFiles is not empty, then we ignore any files that match any of the ignored_file globs. If the change has no files that are outside of the ignoredFiles globs, then we do not trigger a build.

options.name: include_build_logs
options.description: Build logs will be sent back to GitHub as part of the checkrun result. Values can be INCLUDE_BUILD_LOGS_UNSPECIFIED or INCLUDE_BUILD_LOGS_WITH_STATUS.

options.name: included_files
options.description: ignoredFiles and includedFiles are file glob matches using https://golang.org/pkg/path/filepath/#Match extended with support for `**`. If any of the files altered in the commit pass the ignoredFiles filter and includedFiles is empty, then as far as this filter is concerned, we should trigger the build. If any of the files altered in the commit pass the ignoredFiles filter and includedFiles is not empty, then we make sure that at least one of those files matches a includedFiles glob. If not, then

options.name: location
options.description: The [Cloud Build location](https://cloud.google.com/build/docs/locations) for the trigger. If not specified, "global" is used. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the trigger. Must be unique within the project.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: pubsub_config
options.description: PubsubConfig describes the configuration of a trigger that creates a build whenever a Pub/Sub message is published.

options.name: repository_event_config
options.description: The configuration of a trigger that creates a build whenever an event from Repo API is received.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account
options.description: The service account used for all user-controlled operations including triggers.patch, triggers.run, builds.create, and builds.cancel. If no service account is set, then the standard Cloud Build service account ([PROJECT_NUM]@system.gserviceaccount.com) will be used instead. Format: projects/{PROJECT_ID}/serviceAccounts/{ACCOUNT_ID_OR_EMAIL}.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: source_to_build
options.description: The repo and ref of the repository from which to build. This field is used only for those triggers that do not respond to SCM events. Triggers that respond to such events build source at whatever commit caused the event. This field is currently only used by Webhook, Pub/Sub, Manual, and Cron triggers.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.

options.name: substitutions
options.description: Substitutions data for Build resource.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags for annotation of a BuildTrigger.

options.name: trigger_template
options.description: Template describing the types of source changes to trigger a build. Branch and tag names in trigger templates are interpreted as regular expressions. Any branch or tag change that matches that regular expression will trigger a build.

options.name: webhook_config
options.description: WebhookConfig describes the configuration of a trigger that creates a build whenever a webhook is sent to a trigger's webhook URL.
